title: Finite equality detection for raw stage section representatives
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$, let $V$ be a cocone with vertex $C$, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on $C$. Assume every transition $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. For $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ put $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$ and $V_t=V_{t.right}$. Give sheaf maps $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^sA_{t'}$ for $b:t\to t'$, whose composites with the inverse-image unit of $G$ are the unit at $t'$, componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. Let $B:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ and $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^pB_t$ exhibit $B_t$ as the left Kan extension along $V_t^{op}$. Assume $\beta_t(X) B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of the arrow category of sets. Write $H=\mathrm{colim}\,B$ and $\rho_t(X)(s)=\iota_t(V_tX)(\beta_t(X)(s))$. Fix $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, a finite set $K$, objects $X_p\in F(t.right)$ and sections $r_p,s_p\in A_t(X_p)$ for $p\in K$. If $\rho_t(X_p)(r_p)=\rho_t(X_p)(s_p)$ for every $p$, then there are $t\to t\prime$ with arrow $b$ such that $\theta_b(X_p)(r_p)=\theta_b(X_p)(s_p)$ for every $p$. This detects equality at finitely many objects; it asserts neither compatibility nor amalgamation of a covering family.

proof.text: Use injectivity of the sheaf adjunction hom-equivalence and the unit equations htheta to prove composition of theta, including the equality transport induced by F.map_comp. This is the composition calculation in ColimitSiteRawSectionDiagram, repeated locally as a proved helper.

For each p evaluate the presheaf colimit at V_t(X_p). Evaluation preserves colimits, and Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff' gives a single arrow b:t->k on which the beta images agree. The Arrow equality hbeta-map preserves equality of inputs, so the beta_k images of theta_b(r_p) and theta_b(s_p) agree. Apply raw_section_kan_unit_relations at k and at the arbitrary object F(b.right)(X_p). Composition of theta identifies the resulting equality with equality along the composite arrow from t.

Choose the resulting k_p and b_p for each p. Mathlib IsFiltered.wideSpan gives a single receiving object k, arrows c_p:k_p->k and an arrow b:t->k with b_p followed by c_p equal to b. Apply theta_(c_p) to each equality and then the proved composition equation and its equality transport to obtain the required equality for b. wideSpan also covers the empty finite family.

theorem colimit_site_raw_finite_equality_stabilization
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (t : Under i) (K : Type u) [Finite K] (X : K → F.obj t.right)
    (r s : ∀ p, ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
      (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op (X p)))
    (hrs : ∀ p,
      (colimit.ι B t).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj (X p)))
          ((β t).app (op (X p)) (r p)) =
        (colimit.ι B t).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj (X p)))
          ((β t).app (op (X p)) (s p))) :
    ∃ (t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'), ∀ p,
      (θ t t' b).hom.app (op (X p)) (r p) =
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op (X p)) (s p)
